purpose: Prospective comparison of the frozen local and local-plus-GFS models without retrospective tuning
target: Observed LTFJ ceiling strictly below 500 ft AGL within (t,t+3h], currently not below threshold
prediction_schedule: UTC :00 and :30 when a current LTFJ observation is no more than 35 minutes old
gfs_availability_rule: Use only a forecast cycle treated as available at least 6 hours after initialization; record actual retrieval time prospectively
primary_metric: Paired Brier score difference on all prospectively eligible matched origins
uncertainty: Paired non-overlapping 7-day block bootstrap with 95 percent intervals
decision_rule: Do not replace the current model unless GFS has positive Brier skill with a 95 percent interval excluding zero and does not materially worsen the pre-frozen alarm tradeoff
guardrails: Store prediction, retrieval time, source cycle, model hashes and input hashes before the outcome window ends.
Append outcomes later; never rewrite a recorded probability.
Do not tune features, calibration or alarm thresholds during the evaluation window.
Report missing predictions and source outages rather than filling them from future data.
A safety or operational decision requires domain review beyond this research protocol.
